name: Qianliu API (千流 API)
description: Qianliu API is a metered model gateway. Developers can browse group prices before funding an account. The OpenAPI quickstart lists models available to a group key and shows how to send a paid Chat Completions request. Video teams can look up separate Seedance 2.5 and MiniMax H3 rates in the model catalog.
